/**
 * booking-service — the job lifecycle and its state machine.
 *
 * ADR-001: a booking is created in PENDING_PAYMENT and returns its id and the
 * server-computed fee. It moves to PAID only when payment.completed arrives, and
 * booking.created is published on that transition — so dispatch can never run for
 * an unpaid job.
 */
import express from 'express';
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { CANCELLABLE, EventBus, authenticate, canTransition, cancellationIncursFee, clampAtZero, conflict, created, errorHandler, forbidden, installBigIntJson, isBookingStatus, logger, mountHealth, notFound, ok, paginate, requestContext, requireInternal, unprocessable, wrap, } from '@fixam4me/shared';
import { bookingReference, callFeeFor, cancellationFee, paymentTtlMinutes } from './fees.js';
import { assertClientMayBook } from './identity.js';
installBigIntJson();
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3003);
const prisma = new PrismaClient();
const bus = new EventBus(process.env.RABBITMQ_URL, 'booking-service');
const app = express();
app.use(express.json({ limit: '2mb' }));
app.use(requestContext);
mountHealth(app, 'booking-service', async () => {
    await prisma.$queryRaw `SELECT 1`;
    return true;
});
/** Records a transition and its log entry inside one transaction. */
async function transition(tx, bookingId, from, to, note, extra = {}) {
    if (!canTransition(from, to)) {
        throw unprocessable(`Cannot move a booking from ${from} to ${to}`, 'INVALID_TRANSITION');
    }
    const booking = await tx.booking.update({ where: { id: bookingId }, data: { status: to, ...extra } });
    await tx.bookingStatusLog.create({ data: { bookingId, status: to, note } });
    return booking;
}
// --------------------------------------------------------------- creation
const createSchema = z.object({
    serviceType: z.string().min(2),
    serviceIssue: z.string().optional(),
    description: z.string().optional(),
    photoUrls: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
    jobType: z.enum(['STANDARD', 'EMERGENCY', 'SCHEDULED']).default('STANDARD'),
    scheduledAt: z.string().optional(),
    locationLat: z.number(),
    locationLng: z.number(),
    locationAddress: z.string().optional(),
            serviceType: updated.serviceType, jobType: updated.jobType,
            locationLat: updated.locationLat, locationLng: updated.locationLng,
            callFee: updated.callFee.toString(), attempt: 1,
        }, updated.reference);
        logger.info('booking paid, dispatch may begin', { bookingId: updated.id, reference: updated.reference });
    }, alreadyProcessed);
}
/**
 * ADR-002: unpaid bookings expire so they cannot accumulate forever or hold a promo
 * reservation. Retained as CANCELLED so abandoned checkout stays measurable.
 */
async function expireUnpaidBookings() {
    const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - paymentTtlMinutes() * 60_000);
    const stale = await prisma.booking.findMany({
        where: { status: 'PENDING_PAYMENT', createdAt: { lt: cutoff } }, take: 100,
    });
    for (const booking of stale) {
        try {
            await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
                await transition(tx, booking.id, 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CANCELLED', 'Payment not received in time', { cancelReason: 'PAYMENT_NOT_RECEIVED', cancelledAt: new Date() });
                if (booking.promoCode) {
                    await tx.promoCode.updateMany({
                        where: { code: booking.promoCode, usedCount: { gt: 0 } }, data: { usedCount: { decrement: 1 } },
                    });
                }
            });
            logger.info('expired unpaid booking', { bookingId: booking.id, reference: booking.reference });
        }
        catch (e) {
            logger.error('failed to expire booking', e, { bookingId: booking.id });
        }
    }
}
async function main() {
    await bus.connect();
    await startConsumers();
    setInterval(() => { void expireUnpaidBookings(); }, 60_000);
    app.listen(PORT, () => logger.info('booking-service listening', { port: PORT }));
}
main().catch((e) => { logger.error('startup failed', e); process.exit(1); });
for (const sig of ['SIGTERM', 'SIGINT']) {
    process.on(sig, async () => { await bus.close(); await prisma.$disconnect(); process.exit(0); });
}
